title: The Basement of Unfinished Arrivals

features.name: the incomplete registry
features.desc-on-touch: A guest book lying open to a page where every signature tails off mid-letter. Pens lie nearby as if everyone put them down at the same instant.

features.name: the stacked luggage
features.desc-on-touch: Suitcases piled without order, none of them claimed. You remember arriving with one of these. You don't remember which. You never left.

features.name: the ticket archive
features.desc-on-touch: Stubs and boarding passes under glass, each one headed somewhere else. The destinations have been crossed out and replaced with coordinates that don't exist on any map.

features.name: the name-tag bloom
features.desc-on-touch: Dozens of plastic badges pinned to a cork board: Hello, I Am _____ (blank). Hello, I Am _____ (smudged). Hello, I Am Still Here.

features.name: the half-written letter archive
features.desc-on-touch: Letters begun but never finished, addressed to people the writer could no longer find. The ink fades mid-sentence. Some carry only a salutation and signature.

features.name: the fluorescent that learned patience
features.desc-on-touch: A light tube flickers once per minute, a rhythm slower than heartbeat. It has been patient for decades. It knows arrivals don't always become departures.

inscription: the place where coming to stop is also a kind of arrival

file.name: Motel_Guest_Register_1987-2003_Water_Damage_Pages_Preserved_In_Amber_Resin.tmp
file.note: Names, dates, room numbers — many entries end mid-word, ink running as if written during a flood. Checkouts never recorded. Nobody left and nobody stayed; they simply stopped checking in.

exits.label: back up to the lobby where staying became a choice
further down where unfinished things teach each other completion
along the basement toward the understory's deep file-dark
